findings.detail: The v1.6 public-DUT scheduler test executes only nine representatives. It does not satisfy ADC_TOP_Design.md:891-893, which requires traversal of single N=1..63 and DDC N=2..63 across f=0..3 and d=0..2, plus invalid DDC N=0, mode3, precision3, d=3, and pure-ADC E/d-ignore behavior. The maximum N=63 f1/f3 prefix and 12-bit long-gap checks are reference-only assertions rather than observed DUT behavior. The invalid-factor test at test_adc_top.py:935 covers only single N=0 and DDC N=1. A VMware 14/14 PASS therefore does not close the frozen v1.6 scheduler and invalid-map acceptance matrix.

The cfg_wr_safe test closes the gate with an enabled channel but never creates the distinct pre-write state AFE_EN==0 and AFE_IDLE!=8'hff. ADC_TOP_Design.md:894 requires both enabled and non-idle-only unsafe cases before reopening at all-disabled/all-idle. Consequently the global shared-static update gate is not fully proven at the packet-drain boundary even though the RTL expression itself is structurally correct.

residual_risks: Release-baseline verification, role separation, hashes, source ownership, lint integration and finalization-patch simulation all pass, but the two semantic-coverage blockers prevent acceptance and the patch must not be finalized.

Static RTL audit found the v1.6 E={N,f} legality, 12-bit payload/gap formulas, corrected single f1 64N-32 gap, unsigned 64-bit terminal accumulation, three-state RXD FSM, eight explicit history slices, cfg_wr_safe register behavior, reset/CDC ownership and DDC/FIFO semantics consistent with the finalized design.

The ADI modified-third-party provenance and hash-matched PUB FWFT/CDC boundary are intact; validate_rtl_style.py returns the expected RTL_STYLE_DELTA_REVIEW_REQUIRED for MODIFIED_THIRD_PARTY_RTL and no owned-RTL style blocker was found.
PPA remains HYPOTHESIS and MODEL_EQUIVALENCE remains NON_VENDOR_EQUIVALENT. VCS/Verdi, integrated XSIM, synthesis, implementation, timing closure, bitstream and board validation remain NOT_RUN.
